name: Resonance
storyline:
Play as Maria, a girl with mysterious telekinetic powers held in a dark government facility.

Visceral Rampage
Unleash the full extent of Maria's powers. Use your telekinetic voice to brutally force your way through the containment complex, be it by violently flinging vulnerable enemies against walls, chucking their lifeless bodies at their compatriots, or performing devastating AoE attacks that make the ground shake. Adapt and improve in your skills as you encounter more and more obstacles on your path to freedom.

Cathartic Destruction
Control the facility trying to control you. Pick up furniture, barriers, or enemies themselves to either use as a shield against incoming bullets or as projectiles to launch at enemies. Learn how to best combine your abilities with the environment to wreak absolute havoc on surrounding areas, channeling Maria's destructive mania.

The Dark Facility
Experience Dystopian Noir. Find yourself in an environment unlike any other: a dark, oppressive facility soaked in black and white that you seek to drench in the blood red of your captors. Push through the complex as you hear the eerie drone and metal clanking of it trying to keep you under its control.
summary: Wield your telekinetic voice in Resonance, a short twin-stick top-down action game. Sweep away enemies, raise and hurl objects, use them as a shield, and escape the dark facility trying to contain your powers.
